summary: Harden URL shortener against concurrent redirect click count loss using atomic SQLite updates and upserts, and replace EnsureCreatedAsync with automated legacy bootstrap and EF Core migrations.

affected.reason: Update GetRedirectAsync to use ExecuteUpdateAsync for atomic lifetime click increment and SQLite INSERT ON CONFLICT upsert for daily clicks without in-memory mutations.
Replace Database.EnsureCreatedAsync() with legacy database schema bootstrap logic and Database.MigrateAsync().
Indirect dependent of LinkService and Program serving the redirect endpoint with updated persistence behavior.
Endpoint execution path changes to perform atomic database updates and upserts instead of in-memory counter increments.
Lifetime ClickCount and LastVisitedAt are updated atomically in the SQLite database row on redirect.
Daily Clicks counter is incremented or initialized via atomic SQLite upsert on redirect.
Handwritten initial EF Core migration defining ShortLinks and ShortLinkDailyClicks tables with DbContext and Migration metadata attributes.
Add concurrency test verifying 100 parallel redirects atomically increment lifetime and daily clicks without lost updates.
Add legacy database bootstrap upgrade test verifying pre-existing SQLite databases migrate successfully without data loss.

risks.risk: SQLite concurrency locking or transient database busy errors under high-volume concurrent redirect upserts.
risks.mitigation: Utilize atomic SQL statements (ExecuteUpdateAsync and INSERT ON CONFLICT) with appropriate SQLite busy timeout and connection configuration, validated by 100-request parallel redirect tests.

risks.risk: Partial legacy database upgrade failure leaving __EFMigrationsHistory in an inconsistent state if interrupted.
risks.mitigation: Wrap CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS and __EFMigrationsHistory bootstrap seeding in an explicit database transaction prior to calling Database.MigrateAsync().
